verdict.rationale: Justworks is a SaaS payroll/PEO platform, not an agent, so an official MCP server is a plausible offering and the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions an MCP server or any agent-facing endpoint. The docs cover only payroll, benefits, time off, onboarding and the Xero integration, and the probes for llms.txt and OpenAPI both returned 404.
